# A hand-written sample of the `launchctl print` format, to be replaced by output captured on a
# device.
system/dev.hostkeeper.hostkeeper = {


    active count = 1
    a line without an equals sign
    path = /Library/LaunchDaemons/dev.hostkeeper.hostkeeper.plist
    endpoints = {
        "dev.hostkeeper.socket" = {
            port = 0
            state = active
        }
    }
    future key = some future value
    state = running

      properties = keepalive | runatload
    event triggers = {
        example.trigger => {
            state = active
        }
    }

    pid = 4242

    last exit code = (never exited)
}
this line follows the closing brace and is ignored
